raw_output:
alias: 日落时调节客厅空调温度
description: 日落时如果客厅室温低于18度且窗户关闭，把空调设到22度。
mode: single
triggers:
  - platform: sun
    event: sunset
conditions:
  - condition: template
    value_template: "{{ (states('sensor.living_room_temperature') | float) < 18 and (states('binary_sensor.living_window') == 'off') }}"
actions:
  - service: climate.set_temperature
    target:
      entity_id: climate.living_ac
    data:
      temperature: 22
